title: Snoop Dogg Is Hiring an Ice Cream Taster & It Pays $10k a Month
summary: Apply now if you think you have what it takes.
contentText:
We hope you like ice cream, because Snoop Dogg and his ice cream company Dr. Bombay is looking for an official taste tester.

Snoop has teamed up with global HR firm Deel to find the perfect candidate. The job is fully remote, pays an impressive $10,000 a month and anyone anywhere in the world can apply.

In a video posted to his social media , the rap legend made a call to action. “I’m hiring an international ice cream taster here at Dr. Bombay,” he said. “10 grand a month, you can apply anywhere in the world. Turns out going global is not that easy. See, I love the paper, but not the paperwork. But all that is handled by Deel, and who knows? If you keep it player, you might end up here with me. So, are you ready to be Dr. Bombay’s official ice cream taster? Then go to Deel.com/Snoop and apply.”

Hold on now!!!! I’m hiring an international ice-cream taster 😅🧊🔥🫵🏿❗️ $10K per month. U can apply from anywhere in the world. Applications open 👇🏿 pic.twitter.com/D73g2wYy8V

— Snoop Dogg (@SnoopDogg) August 27, 2026

Dr. Bombay is known for their nostalgic flavors like Long Beach Fruit Cart, Sticky Caramel Apple Pie and Peanut Butter Jelly Time. You can shop the ice cream here .

See below for the job description and what they’re looking for in the person they hire.

Job Description:

- Track food and flavor trends across global markets

- Surface what’s culturally relevant and socially resonant

- Report back on what people are eating, drinking, sharing, and talking about

- Capture content from tasting in a way that feels native to social

- Act as Dr. Maya’s eyes and ears on the ground

- Contribute ideas for flavor inspiration and marketing concepts

- Join check-ins with Dr. Maya and team to discuss findings

- A real shot at shaping a live campaign and future flavor direction

Requirements:

- Deep interest in food, culture, and trend discovery

- Strong social instincts

- Comfortable writing up simple findings

- Outgoing, curious

- Essential Requirement: Ability to perform sensory evaluations (taste, aroma,

- texture) of dairy-based ice cream products

- Speaks English; additional languages a plus

- Interest in entrepreneurship, brand-building, or product creation is a bonus

- Three-month fixed-term independent contractor engagement

- Open to non-traditional applicants and creators

You can apply here .
